claims.quote: as the block size increased from daily to weekly and monthly, there was a marked reduction in the number of points classified as Exponentiated Weibull – the distribution that previously dominated – and a corresponding increase in the standard Weibull distribution
claims.rule: the exponentiated Weibull decided at fewer cells, and the Weibull at more, at each step daily → weekly → monthly (Anderson–Darling)

claims.where: south of South America (40–58° S, 80–56° W)
claims.quote: In the daily block, … the Generalized Gamma gains prominence along the coastal region south of South America
claims.rule: the generalized gamma the most frequent decided choice in the box, daily maxima (Anderson–Darling)

claims.quote: In the weekly block, the distinction between the northern, central, and southern ACC sectors weakens substantially, with the Generalized Gamma expanding its spatial influence
claims.rule: the generalized gamma decided at more cells in the weekly block than in the daily (Anderson–Darling)

claims.quote: By the monthly block, this diversity nearly disappears: the Exponentiated Weibull dominates most of the Southern Ocean, with only small residual areas of Gumbel
claims.rule: the exponentiated Weibull the decided choice at more than half the certified cells, monthly maxima (Anderson–Darling)

claims.where: the monsoon Indian Ocean (0–25° N, 45–80° E)
claims.quote: as the block size increases, a transition toward the standard Weibull distribution occurs
claims.rule: the Weibull decided at more cells in the monthly block than in the daily (Anderson–Darling)

claims.where: the western Pacific south of Japan (24–36° N, 124–148° E)
claims.quote: in the monthly block, the Exponentiated Weibull again becomes dominant
claims.rule: the exponentiated Weibull the decided choice at more than half the certified cells, monthly maxima (Anderson–Darling)

claims.quote: Across most mid- and high-latitude ocean basins, including the North Atlantic, North Pacific, and Arabian Sea, a systematic reduction in estimated Hs values is observed as the block size increases
claims.rule: at more than half the certified cells, the 100-year level of the monthly block's decided family lies wholly below the daily block's
